decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Provision for disabled access to the building and the upper
    ground floor flats shall be made in accordance with details
    to be submitted and approved by the Council prior to the
    occupation of the building.  This shall be implemented and
    permanently maintained when the property is in occupation.

Condition : 2 - Detailed drawings of an amended configuration of the top
    part of the rear wing shall be submitted to and approved by
    the Council before this part of the building is to be
    constructed.

Condition : 3 - Details of the brick bonding pattern and mortar finish shall
    be submitted to and approved by the Council before
    development commences on site.

Condition : 4 - The roof covering to the main slope shall be metal, in
    accordance with a sample to be submitted to and approved by
    the Council before work commences on this part of the
    development.

Condition : 5 - The development shall be constructed in strict accordance with the drawings hereby approved or drawings which are subsequently approved pursuant to conditions which are attached to this planning permission.

Condition : 6 - The recessed central element on the front elevation above
    the entrance door shall be in coblat blue glazed bricks.

Condition : 7 - Detailed sections of the roof at scale 1:10 shall be
    submitted to and approved by the Council prior to work
    commencing on this part of the development.
Condition : 8 - In order to ensure compliance with Council policies.

Condition : 9 - To improve the visual appearance of this part of the
    building.

Condition : 10 - To ensure a high standard of finish in the conservation
    area.
Condition : 11 - To improve the visual appearance of the building.

Condition : 12 - To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the
    character of the immediate area.(DD04)

Condition : 13 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building.

Condition : 14 - To ensure that the Council may be satisfied with the
    external appearance of the building.
description:
Demolition of existing buildings and erection of a basement,
three storey and attic building to provide 10 self contained
1-bedroom units for homeless single women,
as shown on drawing numbers>  2331/01, /02, /03,
98.076/P.001, 98.076/P.002, 98.076/P.003A, 98.076/P.004,
98.076/P.07 98.076/SK08, 98.076/SK09;
two letters dated 27th November 1998 and samples of
materials.
